does: Applies the activation rule to one character: gets its result (1 activate now, 2 asleep and waiting for an anchor, 3 deactivate now, 4 awake and to sleep unless near an anchor) and calls SetActive or files the character into the manager's wake (+0x200) or sleep (+0x230) candidate sets.

evidence.says: calls 0x41A7070 for the result and the helper's virtual +8 (SetActive) with 1 or 0; result 2 ensures the entity in the set at +0x200, result 4 in the set at +0x230; checks the Active component pointer at +0xD0 of the view
a count-only probe shows 1717 calls in 3 s from +0x41A4599, 17 a tick: one per character of the level's query
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
